ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of the old days

plain.li: Back in the house I grew up in, and every room exactly as I left it, down to the cup on the table.
In my dream the colony was new again: one wall, one fire, and all of us still strangers.
A street I haven't walked in years. I knew every crack in it.
[old] Dreamt I was young and fast and couldn't think why everyone kept calling me by my grandmother's name.
[child] I dreamt about when I was small. Smaller than now, I mean.

warm.li: Dreamt of the people I've shared meals with, all of them, from every place I've lived, crammed onto one bench.

blunt.li: Dreamt about the old days. They weren't that good. Still miss them.

cheerful.li: In the dream I found my favorite coat from when I was twenty, and it still fit!

gloomy.li: Dreamt of the old days. They're further off every time.

cold.li: A dream about the past. Pleasant, and of no practical use.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of putting something down

plain.li: Dreamt I'd been carrying a sack of stones up a hill for years, and someone told me I could just put it down. So I did.
In the dream all the doors in the colony were open, and none of us was afraid of that.
The night was quiet in my dream, really quiet, and I slept inside the dream as well.
[child] I dreamt the scary thing went away and didn't come back, and then we had pudding.

warm.li: The ones I was worried about came walking in through the gate, one after the other, all fine.

blunt.li: Dreamt it was over. It is over. Good.

cheerful.li: I dreamt I was a feather. Very light. Highly recommended.

gloomy.li: It was all over, in the dream, and I kept waiting for the next thing, and it never came.

cold.li: A dream of the threat resolved. Accurate, for once.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of keeping someone safe

plain.li: Something small and warm in both hands, and if I kept very still it would be all right.
In my dream I tucked a blanket around someone who was sleeping, and they smiled without waking.
Sitting up by a sickbed all night, in the dream, and the fever broke just before dawn.
[child] I dreamt I had a baby bird and I fed it and it grew up and it remembered me.

warm.li: In the dream I was looking after everyone at once, and I had as many hands as I needed.

blunt.li: Dreamt I kept someone safe. Nice change.

cheerful.li: Dreamt about a whole litter of something fluffy, and they all wanted me. Best dream this month.

gloomy.li: I was keeping someone safe in the dream, and never saw their face. I keep looking at faces today.

cold.li: A dream of caretaking. I was competent at it, which is reassuring.

plain.li: Looking for {OTHER_nameDef} all night, room after room, and every room was empty.
Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} was calling for me from the other side of a river, and I couldn't find the bridge.
In the dream {OTHER_nameDef} kept walking away, and however fast I ran I stayed the same distance behind.
[again] The searching dream again. {OTHER_nameDef} was nearer this time.

warm.li: Dreamt I found {OTHER_nameDef} at last, sitting by a fire, perfectly fine and wondering what the fuss was about.

gloomy.li: Dreamt {OTHER_nameDef} didn't come back. I've told myself three times since that it was only a dream.

cold.li: {OTHER_nameDef} in danger, all night. Worry, translated into pictures. I'll check on {OTHER_objective}.

ColonyCouncil.DreamDef.label: a dream of a long table

plain.li: Dreamt of a table so long it went out of the hall and across the fields, with everyone I know sitting at it.
We were all singing the same song, and nobody knew the words, and it didn't matter.
Dreamt we built a house in one night, all of us, each carrying something, and no one was tired after.
[child] Everybody played with me at once in my dream, and nobody had to go and work.

warm.li: Dreamt I belonged somewhere. Woke up and found I still did.

blunt.li: Good dream. Friends in it. That's all.

cheerful.li: Dreamt of the best party there ever was, and I was invited, and so was everyone!

gloomy.li: Dreamt we were all together and happy. I'm writing it down so I remember we can be.

cold.li: A dream of the colony working as one. Efficient, and oddly moving.

plain.li: A storm was trying to push me off a hill, and I simply wouldn't go.
Climbing a cliff with no top, and every handhold held.
Something huge came at me out of the dark, and I planted my feet, and it went around me like water around a stone.
[again] The dream about the hill again. The wind is weaker every time.

warm.li: Dreamt I was the wall, and everyone I love was on the other side of me, safe.

blunt.li: Dreamt I didn't back down. I won't.

cheerful.li: Wrestled a thrumbo in my dream and won. Ready for anything today.

gloomy.li: It all went wrong in the dream and I kept going anyway, one foot, then the other.

cold.li: A dream of endurance. Instructive. I've noted the parts that applied.
